output_list.reason: Re-entrancy vulnerability: in function approve, function transferFrom, function distribute, function transfer and function constructor , the approve and transferFrom functions of ERC20 Token Contract can be called by an attacker before completing their transaction if he transfer his own tokens or approve a spender and his spender transfer his tokens to other addresses in the fallback function. Once tokens are approved he can just transfer them until there is enough balance. Thus the attacker can increase profit drastically while exploiting the re-entrancy vulnerability in approve, transferFrom, distribute, transfer and constructor functions.
